description: This file contains a test suite named CoverageDumpTests that checks the periodic flushing of coverage profiles by invoking a function based on LLVM profile writing. It defines a test method to run asynchronously, attempting to write coverage data over a 4-second window, and includes a helper function for resolving the profile write symbol from the dynamic linker.

methods.name: periodically flush coverage
methods.description: An asynchronous test method that repeatedly triggers coverage profile writes at 250ms intervals for 4 seconds, if the environment variable and symbol resolution succeed.
